note: IELTS Academic Writing lesson bodies, phase 2 (SPEC-lessons rev. 2, 12 Oct 2026, §4.7, §12.5 item 2, C-18, C-19, C-36; lane p7-writing, 13 Oct 2026). Lesson 1 of the C10 units IEWR01 and IEWR02 (Task 1: the introduction sentence and the overview) and IEWR03 and IEWR04 (Task 2: one body paragraph). Each lesson is three pieces (the idea, a model paragraph on ANOTHER prompt, the trap) and ends with the student's own paragraph (`writing`): she writes 60-150 words, gets feedback on four criteria in her language with no band (C-18), and revises; the revision is the task (C-19). No piece questions and no keyed items, so there is nothing for a blind key check: key check 2 is the automatic check in tests/unit/lessons-writing/content.test.ts (every model paragraph's words counted, every number and trend it states read against its own data, the uz lines linted for U+02BB/U+02BC). Our own wording, our own invented data and questions: no College Board, IELTS, Cambridge, British Council, IDP, Khan or OpenStax item or text; the four criteria are said in our own words. The uz and ru lines need a native read before real families.

title.en: IELTS Writing: The overview of a line graph
title.uz: IELTS Writing: Chiziqli grafikning umumiy tavsifi

body.en:
In Task 1 you describe a chart. Two parts come first:
1. One sentence that says what the chart shows, in your own words.
2. The overview: 2 or 3 sentences about the biggest things the chart shows. What went up? What went down? What was the highest at the end?
Start the overview with "Overall,". Leave the small numbers for later paragraphs.
body.uz:
Task 1 da siz grafikni tasvirlaysiz. Avval ikki qism yoziladi:
1. Grafik nimani koʻrsatishini oʻz soʻzlaringiz bilan aytadigan bitta gap.
2. Umumiy tavsif (overview): grafik koʻrsatayotgan eng muhim oʻzgarishlar haqida 2-3 gap. Nima oshdi? Nima kamaydi? Oxirida qaysi biri eng yuqori boʻldi?
Umumiy tavsifni «Overall,» bilan boshlang. Mayda raqamlarni keyingi xatboshilarga qoldiring.
body.ru:
В Task 1 вы описываете график. Сначала пишутся две части:
1. Одно предложение о том, что показывает график, своими словами.
2. Обзор (overview): 2-3 предложения о самом главном на графике. Что выросло? Что упало? Что было самым высоким в конце?
Начните обзор с «Overall,». Конкретные цифры оставьте для следующих абзацев.

body.en:
A model on another chart (our own example). Visitors to a city park, in thousands:
2010: summer 40, winter 10
2015: summer 55, winter 12
2020: summer 70, winter 9

The line graph compares how many people visited a city park in summer and in winter between 2010 and 2020. Overall, the park was far busier in summer than in winter in every year shown. Summer visitor numbers rose steadily over the decade, while winter numbers stayed low and changed very little. By 2020, the park had almost eight times as many visitors in summer as in winter.
body.uz:
Boshqa grafik boʻyicha namuna (oʻzimizning misol). Shahar bogʻiga kelganlar, ming kishi:
2010: yozda 40, qishda 10
2015: yozda 55, qishda 12
2020: yozda 70, qishda 9

The line graph compares how many people visited a city park in summer and in winter between 2010 and 2020. Overall, the park was far busier in summer than in winter in every year shown. Summer visitor numbers rose steadily over the decade, while winter numbers stayed low and changed very little. By 2020, the park had almost eight times as many visitors in summer as in winter.

Eʼtibor bering: birinchi gap grafikni oʻz soʻzlari bilan aytadi, «Overall,» dan keyin esa faqat eng katta oʻzgarishlar keladi.
body.ru:
Образец по другому графику (наш собственный пример). Посетители городского парка, тыс. человек:
2010: летом 40, зимой 10
2015: летом 55, зимой 12
2020: летом 70, зимой 9

The line graph compares how many people visited a city park in summer and in winter between 2010 and 2020. Overall, the park was far busier in summer than in winter in every year shown. Summer visitor numbers rose steadily over the decade, while winter numbers stayed low and changed very little. By 2020, the park had almost eight times as many visitors in summer as in winter.

Обратите внимание: первое предложение пересказывает график своими словами, а после «Overall,» идут только главные изменения.

body.en: Two traps. First: a list of numbers is not an overview ("In 2010 it was 40, in 2015 it was 55…"). Say the trend: "rose steadily". Second: copying the question's words. Say the same thing in other words: "shows" can become "compares", "the number of" can become "how many".
body.uz: Ikki tuzoq. Birinchisi: raqamlar roʻyxati umumiy tavsif emas («In 2010 it was 40, in 2015 it was 55…»). Tendensiyani ayting: «rose steadily». Ikkinchisi: savoldagi soʻzlarni koʻchirib yozish. Oʻsha fikrni boshqa soʻzlar bilan ayting: «shows» oʻrniga «compares», «the number of» oʻrniga «how many».
body.ru: Две ловушки. Первая: список цифр — это не обзор («In 2010 it was 40, in 2015 it was 55…»). Назовите тенденцию: «rose steadily». Вторая: переписывать слова задания. Передайте то же самое другими словами: «shows» можно заменить на «compares», «the number of» — на «how many».

prompt.en: The chart below shows the share of households in one town that owned a car, a bicycle and a motorbike in 2000, 2010 and 2020. Write one sentence that says what the chart shows, then an overview of the main trends.

data.en:
Households that owned each vehicle (%):
2000: car 30, bicycle 60, motorbike 25
2010: car 45, bicycle 50, motorbike 20
2020: car 65, bicycle 35, motorbike 15

steer.en: Write in English, 60 to 150 words: one sentence on what the chart shows (in your own words), then 2 or 3 sentences of overview with the biggest changes. No small numbers in the overview.
steer.uz: Ingliz tilida 60-150 soʻz yozing: grafik nimani koʻrsatishi haqida bitta gap (oʻz soʻzlaringiz bilan), keyin eng katta oʻzgarishlar haqida 2-3 gaplik umumiy tavsif. Umumiy tavsifda mayda raqamlar boʻlmasin.
steer.ru: Напишите по-английски 60-150 слов: одно предложение о том, что показывает график (своими словами), затем 2-3 предложения обзора с главными изменениями. Без конкретных цифр в обзоре.

rubric.en: Task: one sentence says what the chart shows; the overview names the main trends (car ownership rose to become the highest, bicycles and motorbikes fell) and does not list every number.

ask.en: Did you say what the chart shows, and name the biggest changes (cars up, bicycles and motorbikes down) without listing every number?
ask.uz: Grafik nimani koʻrsatishini aytdingizmi va eng katta oʻzgarishlarni (avtomobillar soni oshdi, velosiped va mototsikllar soni kamaydi) har bir raqamni sanamasdan nomladingizmi?
ask.ru: Вы сказали, что показывает график, и назвали главные изменения (машин больше, велосипедов и мотоциклов меньше), не перечисляя все цифры?

rubric.en: Organisation: the introduction sentence first, then the overview starting with a signal such as "Overall"; the ideas follow one clear order and are linked.

ask.en: Is the introduction sentence first, and does the overview start with "Overall,"? Do the sentences follow one clear order?
ask.uz: Kirish gapi birinchi turibdimi, umumiy tavsif «Overall,» bilan boshlanadimi? Gaplar bitta aniq tartibda keladimi?
ask.ru: Вступительное предложение стоит первым, а обзор начинается с «Overall,»? Предложения идут в одном ясном порядке?

rubric.en: Words: precise words for change (rose, fell, grew steadily, dropped) and the question's words said in other words, not copied.

ask.en: Did you use words for change (rose, fell, dropped) and say the question in your own words?
ask.uz: Oʻzgarishni bildiradigan soʻzlarni (rose, fell, dropped) ishlatdingizmi, savolni oʻz soʻzlaringiz bilan aytdingizmi?
ask.ru: Вы использовали слова, которые описывают изменения (rose, fell, dropped), и пересказали задание своими словами?

rubric.en: Grammar: past tenses for past years, correct comparisons (higher than, the most popular), articles and plurals.

ask.en: Are the verbs in the past for past years? Check one comparison (higher than, the most) and the plurals.
ask.uz: Oʻtgan yillar uchun feʼllar oʻtgan zamonda turibdimi? Bitta solishtirishni (higher than, the most) va koʻplik shakllarini tekshiring.
ask.ru: Глаголы о прошлых годах стоят в прошедшем времени? Проверьте одно сравнение (higher than, the most) и множественное число.

title.en: IELTS Writing: The overview of a table

body.en:
A table gives many numbers at once. Your overview picks the few that matter:
1. Which item is the biggest, and is it still the biggest at the end?
2. Which item changed the most?
3. Did anything go the other way?
Compare, don't copy: "bus travel became the most common" says more than "bus was 30".
body.uz:
Jadvalda bir vaqtda koʻp raqam boʻladi. Umumiy tavsifingiz ulardan muhimlarini tanlaydi:
1. Qaysi biri eng katta va oxirida ham eng kattami?
2. Qaysi biri eng koʻp oʻzgardi?
3. Biror narsa teskari tomonga oʻzgardimi?
Koʻchirmang, solishtiring: «bus travel became the most common» degan gap «bus was 30» dan koʻproq narsa aytadi.
body.ru:
В таблице сразу много цифр. Обзор выбирает из них главное:
1. Что самое большое и осталось ли оно самым большим в конце?
2. Что изменилось сильнее всего?
3. Изменилось ли что-то в обратную сторону?
Сравнивайте, а не переписывайте: «bus travel became the most common» говорит больше, чем «bus was 30».

body.en:
A model on another table (our own example). Members of three school clubs:
2019: chess 20, football 45, robotics 5
2024: chess 25, football 40, robotics 35

The table shows how many students belonged to three school clubs in 2019 and in 2024. Overall, football was the most popular club in both years, but the robotics club grew the most. While chess and football changed only a little, robotics went from the smallest club to almost the size of football. Football was the only club that lost members.
body.uz:
Boshqa jadval boʻyicha namuna (oʻzimizning misol). Uchta maktab toʻgaragi aʼzolari:
2019: shaxmat 20, futbol 45, robototexnika 5
2024: shaxmat 25, futbol 40, robototexnika 35

The table shows how many students belonged to three school clubs in 2019 and in 2024. Overall, football was the most popular club in both years, but the robotics club grew the most. While chess and football changed only a little, robotics went from the smallest club to almost the size of football. Football was the only club that lost members.

Eʼtibor bering: har bir gap ikki narsani solishtiradi, raqamlarni esa sanab chiqmaydi.
body.ru:
Образец по другой таблице (наш собственный пример). Участники трёх школьных кружков:
2019: шахматы 20, футбол 45, робототехника 5
2024: шахматы 25, футбол 40, робототехника 35

The table shows how many students belonged to three school clubs in 2019 and in 2024. Overall, football was the most popular club in both years, but the robotics club grew the most. While chess and football changed only a little, robotics went from the smallest club to almost the size of football. Football was the only club that lost members.

Обратите внимание: каждое предложение сравнивает, а не перечисляет цифры.

body.en: The trap: reading the table row by row ("Walk was 40 and then 25. Bus was 35 and then 30…"). That is the table again in words. Look across the whole table first, then write what you see from far away. And check your comparisons: "the most common" can be only one item.
body.uz: Tuzoq: jadvalni qatorma-qator oʻqib chiqish («Walk was 40 and then 25. Bus was 35 and then 30…»). Bu jadvalning oʻzi, faqat soʻz bilan. Avval butun jadvalga qarang, keyin uzoqdan nimani koʻrsangiz, shuni yozing. Solishtirishlarni ham tekshiring: «the most common» faqat bitta narsa boʻla oladi.
body.ru: Ловушка: читать таблицу строку за строкой («Walk was 40 and then 25. Bus was 35 and then 30…»). Это та же таблица, только словами. Сначала посмотрите на всю таблицу, потом напишите, что видно, если смотреть на неё целиком. И проверьте сравнения: «the most common» может быть только что-то одно.

prompt.en: The table below shows how students at one school usually travelled to school in 2015 and in 2023. Write one sentence that says what the table shows, then an overview of the main points.

data.en:
Main way to school (% of students):
2015: walk 40, bus 35, car 15, bicycle 10
2023: walk 25, bus 30, car 20, bicycle 25

steer.en: Write in English, 60 to 150 words: one sentence on what the table shows (in your own words), then 2 or 3 sentences of overview that compare. No list of every number.
steer.uz: Ingliz tilida 60-150 soʻz yozing: jadval nimani koʻrsatishi haqida bitta gap (oʻz soʻzlaringiz bilan), keyin solishtiradigan 2-3 gaplik umumiy tavsif. Har bir raqamni sanab chiqmang.
steer.ru: Напишите по-английски 60-150 слов: одно предложение о том, что показывает таблица (своими словами), затем 2-3 предложения обзора со сравнением. Без перечня всех цифр.

rubric.en: Task: one sentence says what the table shows; the overview names the main points (walking was the most common way in 2015 but fell; cycling grew the most; the bus was the most common way in 2023) and does not list every number.

ask.en: Did you say what the table shows, and name the main points (walking fell, cycling grew the most, the bus was the top way in 2023)?
ask.uz: Jadval nimani koʻrsatishini aytdingizmi va asosiy nuqtalarni (piyoda yurish kamaydi, velosipedda yurish eng koʻp oʻsdi, 2023-yilda avtobus birinchi oʻringa chiqdi) nomladingizmi?
ask.ru: Вы сказали, что показывает таблица, и назвали главное (пешком стали ходить меньше, число велосипедистов выросло сильнее всего, в 2023 году на первое место вышел автобус)?

rubric.en: Organisation: the introduction sentence first, then the overview starting with "Overall"; each sentence compares and leads to the next.

ask.en: Is the introduction sentence first, and does each overview sentence compare something?
ask.uz: Kirish gapi birinchi turibdimi, umumiy tavsifdagi har bir gap nimanidir solishtiradimi?
ask.ru: Вступительное предложение стоит первым, и каждое предложение обзора что-то сравнивает?

rubric.en: Words: words that compare and rank (the most common, the least, overtook, while) and the question's words said in other words.

ask.en: Did you use words that compare (the most common, while, more than) and say the question in your own words?
ask.uz: Solishtiradigan soʻzlarni (the most common, while, more than) ishlatdingizmi, savolni oʻz soʻzlaringiz bilan aytdingizmi?
ask.ru: Вы использовали слова сравнения (the most common, while, more than) и пересказали задание своими словами?

rubric.en: Grammar: past tenses for past years, correct comparatives and superlatives, articles and plurals.

ask.en: Are the verbs in the past? Check one comparison (more than, the most) and the articles.
ask.uz: Feʼllar oʻtgan zamondami? Bitta solishtirishni (more than, the most) va artikllarni tekshiring.
ask.ru: Глаголы в прошедшем времени? Проверьте одно сравнение (more than, the most) и артикли.

title.en: IELTS Writing: A body paragraph that answers the question
title.uz: IELTS Writing: Savolga javob beradigan asosiy xatboshi
title.ru: IELTS Writing: Основной абзац, который отвечает на вопрос

body.en:
In Task 2 each body paragraph has one job: one main idea. Build it in four steps:
1. Your point, in the first sentence.
2. Why: explain it.
3. An example: something real or typical.
4. A last sentence that links back to the question.
First read the question twice: what exactly does it ask you to do?
body.uz:
Task 2 da har bir asosiy xatboshining bitta vazifasi bor: bitta asosiy fikr. Uni toʻrt qadamda quring:
1. Birinchi gapda fikringiz.
2. Nega: uni tushuntiring.
3. Misol: hayotiy yoki odatiy holat.
4. Savolga qaytaradigan oxirgi gap.
Avval savolni ikki marta oʻqing: u sizdan aynan nimani soʻrayapti?
body.ru:
В Task 2 у каждого основного абзаца одна задача: одна главная мысль. Стройте его в четыре шага:
1. Ваша мысль — в первом предложении.
2. Почему: объясните её.
3. Пример: реальный или типичный случай.
4. Последнее предложение, которое возвращает к вопросу.
Сначала прочитайте вопрос дважды: что именно вас просят сделать?

body.en:
A model for another question (our own example): "Is it better to learn a foreign language at school or alone at home with apps?"

In my view, the main advantage of learning at school is the teacher's feedback. When a teacher hears a student speak, she can correct a mistake at once, before it becomes a habit. For example, many learners say "I am agree" for years because nobody stops them, while in a class this is usually fixed in the first weeks. Apps can mark an answer wrong, but they rarely explain why. For this reason, I believe school lessons build stronger basics than learning alone.
body.uz:
Boshqa savol uchun namuna (oʻzimizning misol): «Is it better to learn a foreign language at school or alone at home with apps?»

In my view, the main advantage of learning at school is the teacher's feedback. When a teacher hears a student speak, she can correct a mistake at once, before it becomes a habit. For example, many learners say "I am agree" for years because nobody stops them, while in a class this is usually fixed in the first weeks. Apps can mark an answer wrong, but they rarely explain why. For this reason, I believe school lessons build stronger basics than learning alone.

Eʼtibor bering: fikr → nega → misol → savolga qaytish. Bitta xatboshi, bitta fikr.
body.ru:
Образец для другого вопроса (наш собственный пример): «Is it better to learn a foreign language at school or alone at home with apps?»

In my view, the main advantage of learning at school is the teacher's feedback. When a teacher hears a student speak, she can correct a mistake at once, before it becomes a habit. For example, many learners say "I am agree" for years because nobody stops them, while in a class this is usually fixed in the first weeks. Apps can mark an answer wrong, but they rarely explain why. For this reason, I believe school lessons build stronger basics than learning alone.

Обратите внимание: мысль → почему → пример → возврат к вопросу. Один абзац — одна мысль.

body.en: Two traps. First: three ideas in one paragraph, each with one short sentence. Choose your strongest idea and explain it well. Second: answering a different question. If the question asks for your opinion, your first sentence must say what you think.
body.uz: Ikki tuzoq. Birinchisi: bitta xatboshida uchta fikr, har biri bitta qisqa gap bilan. Eng kuchli fikringizni tanlang va uni yaxshi tushuntiring. Ikkinchisi: boshqa savolga javob berish. Agar savol fikringizni soʻrasa, birinchi gapingiz nima deb oʻylashingizni aytishi kerak.
body.ru: Две ловушки. Первая: три мысли в одном абзаце, по одному короткому предложению на каждую. Выберите самую сильную мысль и хорошо её объясните. Вторая: ответ на другой вопрос. Если в вопросе спрашивают ваше мнение, в первом предложении должно быть сказано, что вы думаете.

prompt.en: Some people say that teenagers should have a part-time job while they are at school. Others say teenagers should spend all their free time on their studies. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

steer.en: Write in English, 60 to 150 words: ONE body paragraph with your opinion. Your point first, then why, then an example, then a sentence that links back to the question.
steer.uz: Ingliz tilida 60-150 soʻz yozing: fikringiz bilan BITTA asosiy xatboshi. Avval fikringiz, keyin nega, keyin misol, oxirida savolga qaytaradigan gap.
steer.ru: Напишите по-английски 60-150 слов: ОДИН основной абзац с вашим мнением. Сначала мысль, потом объяснение (почему), потом пример, в конце предложение, которое возвращает к вопросу.

rubric.en: Task: the paragraph answers this question: it gives a clear opinion on part-time jobs or study for teenagers, with one main reason that is explained and supported by an example.

ask.en: Does your first sentence give your opinion on this question? Is there one reason, explained, with an example?
ask.uz: Birinchi gapingiz shu savol boʻyicha fikringizni aytadimi? Bitta sabab bormi, u tushuntirilganmi, misol bilanmi?
ask.ru: В первом предложении есть ваше мнение по этому вопросу? Есть ли одна причина с объяснением и примером?

rubric.en: Organisation: one main idea; point, explanation, example and a link back, in that order; sentences joined with clear links.

ask.en: Is there only one main idea? Do the sentences go point, why, example, link back?
ask.uz: Faqat bitta asosiy fikr bormi? Gaplar fikr, nega, misol, savolga qaytish tartibida keladimi?
ask.ru: Главная мысль одна? Предложения идут в порядке: мысль, почему, пример, возврат к вопросу?

rubric.en: Words: precise words for the topic (earn, experience, responsibility, focus on) instead of very general ones (good, bad, thing), not repeated again and again.

ask.en: Can you change one general word (good, bad, thing) for a more exact one?
ask.uz: Bitta umumiy soʻzni (good, bad, thing) aniqrogʻiga almashtira olasizmi?
ask.ru: Можете заменить одно общее слово (good, bad, thing) на более точное?

rubric.en: Grammar: a mix of simple and longer sentences (because, when, which), correct verb forms and agreement (teenagers are, a teenager is).

ask.en: Is there at least one longer sentence with because, when or which? Check that each verb agrees with its subject.
ask.uz: because, when yoki which bilan kamida bitta uzunroq gap bormi? Har bir feʼl oʻz egasiga mosligini tekshiring.
ask.ru: Есть хотя бы одно длинное предложение с because, when или which? Проверьте, что каждый глагол согласован с подлежащим.

title.en: IELTS Writing: Linking ideas inside a paragraph
title.uz: IELTS Writing: Xatboshi ichida fikrlarni bogʻlash
title.ru: IELTS Writing: Связь мыслей внутри абзаца

body.en:
A good paragraph reads like a chain: each sentence holds on to the one before it. Three simple tools:
1. "This" or "these" + a noun: "This habit…", "These lessons…".
2. Cause and result: because, so, as a result, this means that.
3. The same key word again, or a word close to it.
One linking word per sentence is plenty.
body.uz:
Yaxshi xatboshi zanjirga oʻxshaydi: har bir gap oldingisini ushlab turadi. Uchta oddiy vosita:
1. «This» yoki «these» + ot: «This habit…», «These lessons…».
2. Sabab va natija: because, so, as a result, this means that.
3. Oʻsha kalit soʻzni yoki unga yaqin soʻzni takrorlash.
Har bir gapga bitta bogʻlovchi soʻz yetarli.
body.ru:
Хороший абзац читается как цепочка: каждое предложение держится за предыдущее. Три простых инструмента:
1. «This» или «these» + существительное: «This habit…», «These lessons…».
2. Причина и следствие: because, so, as a result, this means that.
3. То же ключевое слово ещё раз или слово, близкое к нему по смыслу.
Одного связующего слова на предложение достаточно.

body.en:
A model for another question (our own example): "Many students forget what they learned soon after an exam. Why does this happen, and what can be done?"

One major cause is that students often study only on the night before a test. When information is learned in one long session, the memory keeps it for a short time and then loses most of it. As a result, a student may pass on Friday but remember little by Monday. This is why teachers advise short reviews spread over several days. These reviews take the same time in total, but they help new facts stay much longer.
body.uz:
Boshqa savol uchun namuna (oʻzimizning misol): «Many students forget what they learned soon after an exam. Why does this happen, and what can be done?»

One major cause is that students often study only on the night before a test. When information is learned in one long session, the memory keeps it for a short time and then loses most of it. As a result, a student may pass on Friday but remember little by Monday. This is why teachers advise short reviews spread over several days. These reviews take the same time in total, but they help new facts stay much longer.

Eʼtibor bering: «As a result», «This is why», «These reviews» — har bir gap oldingisiga bogʻlangan, lekin «Moreover» bitta ham yoʻq.
body.ru:
Образец для другого вопроса (наш собственный пример): «Many students forget what they learned soon after an exam. Why does this happen, and what can be done?»

One major cause is that students often study only on the night before a test. When information is learned in one long session, the memory keeps it for a short time and then loses most of it. As a result, a student may pass on Friday but remember little by Monday. This is why teachers advise short reviews spread over several days. These reviews take the same time in total, but they help new facts stay much longer.

Обратите внимание: «As a result», «This is why», «These reviews» — каждое предложение связано с предыдущим, и ни одного «Moreover».

body.en: The trap: a linking word at the start of every sentence ("Moreover… Furthermore… In addition… Moreover…"). It sounds like a list, not like thinking, and it is harder to read. Join ideas with "this", "because" and "as a result" where the meaning needs them, and nowhere else.
body.uz: Tuzoq: har bir gap boshida bogʻlovchi soʻz («Moreover… Furthermore… In addition… Moreover…»). Bu fikrlash emas, roʻyxatga oʻxshaydi va oʻqish qiyinlashadi. Fikrlarni «this», «because» va «as a result» bilan faqat maʼno talab qilgan joyda bogʻlang.
body.ru: Ловушка: связующее слово в начале каждого предложения («Moreover… Furthermore… In addition… Moreover…»). Это звучит как список, а не как рассуждение, и читается тяжелее. Связывайте мысли через «this», «because» и «as a result» только там, где этого требует смысл.

prompt.en: In many cities, young people spend much less time outdoors than young people did in the past. What are the causes of this, and what can be done about it?

steer.en: Write in English, 60 to 150 words: ONE body paragraph about one cause (or one solution). Link each sentence to the one before it with this/these, because or as a result. At most one "Moreover".
steer.uz: Ingliz tilida 60-150 soʻz yozing: bitta sabab (yoki bitta yechim) haqida BITTA asosiy xatboshi. Har bir gapni oldingisiga this/these, because yoki as a result bilan bogʻlang. «Moreover» koʻpi bilan bir marta.
steer.ru: Напишите по-английски 60-150 слов: ОДИН основной абзац об одной причине (или одном решении). Связывайте каждое предложение с предыдущим через this/these, because или as a result. «Moreover» — не больше одного раза.

rubric.en: Task: the paragraph answers this question with one cause of young people spending less time outdoors (or one solution), explained and supported with an example.

ask.en: Does your paragraph give one cause (or one solution) for this question, explained, with an example?
ask.uz: Xatboshingiz shu savol uchun bitta sabab (yoki bitta yechim) beradimi, u tushuntirilgan va misol bilanmi?
ask.ru: Ваш абзац даёт одну причину (или одно решение) по этому вопросу, с объяснением и примером?

rubric.en: Linking: each sentence holds on to the one before it (this/these + noun, because, as a result, the key word repeated); linking words are not overused at the start of every sentence.

ask.en: Does each sentence connect to the one before it? Count your "Moreover" and "Furthermore": more than one is too many.
ask.uz: Har bir gap oldingisiga bogʻlanadimi? «Moreover» va «Furthermore» ni sanang: bittadan koʻpi ortiqcha.
ask.ru: Каждое предложение связано с предыдущим? Посчитайте «Moreover» и «Furthermore»: больше одного — уже слишком много.

rubric.en: Words: precise words for causes and effects (screens, free time, safety, physical activity, lead to) instead of very general ones.

ask.en: Can you change one general word for a more exact one about causes or effects (lead to, reduce, physical activity)?
ask.uz: Bitta umumiy soʻzni sabab yoki natija haqidagi aniqroq soʻzga (lead to, reduce, physical activity) almashtira olasizmi?
ask.ru: Можете заменить одно общее слово на более точное слово о причинах или следствиях (lead to, reduce, physical activity)?

rubric.en: Grammar: present tenses for things true today, a mix of simple and longer sentences, correct agreement and plurals.

ask.en: Are things that are true today in the present tense? Check that each verb agrees with its subject.
ask.uz: Bugun ham toʻgʻri boʻlgan narsalar hozirgi zamondami? Har bir feʼl oʻz egasiga mosligini tekshiring.
ask.ru: То, что верно сегодня, написано в настоящем времени? Проверьте согласование каждого глагола с подлежащим.
